replacement.name: Dawn Homestay (Kigwema)
replacement.tagline: Rovi Yhoshii's home in Kigwema, Nagaland's canonical Dzukou trek-base homestay — clean rooms, hearty Naga meals, hosts who arrange Zakhama/Viswema trailhead transfers.
replacement.address: Kigwema Village, Kohima District, Nagaland — 5 km from Zakhama trailhead, 11 km from Viswema

replacement.name: Viswema Village Homestays (community-run)
replacement.tagline: The Angami village at the southern Dzukou trailhead has a small cluster of community-run homestays bookable via NagalandTourism.com — closest budget beds before the 4-hour climb to the meadow.
replacement.address: Viswema Village, Kohima District (NH-2 / Imphal road, 25 km south of Kohima)

replacement.name: Kigwema Village Homestays (Zakhama-side trailhead cluster)
replacement.tagline: Closest cluster to the Zakhama trailhead — you walk to your taxi pickup, not to the valley itself (no human settlement in Dzukou). Best for early-start trekkers.
replacement.address: Kigwema Village, Kohima District — 5 km from Zakhama and 11 km from Viswema trailheads

replacement.name: Dzukou Valley Rest House / Trekkers' Hut (Pilgrim's Inn)
replacement.tagline: The only accommodation inside the meadow — basic dormitory + a couple of VIP cabins run by the Southern Angami Public Organisation. Bring sleeping bag; blankets ₹50, dorm ₹50–₹100/night, no electricity.
replacement.address: Dzukou Valley meadow, ~4 hour climb from Viswema or Zakhama trailheads, Kohima District

replacement.name: Helsa Morung Retreat
replacement.tagline: Konyak-family homestay run by a village head-woman — 5 Konyak-style cottages + 8 bamboo cottages + 5 deluxe tents on a forest clearing styled like a traditional Konyak morung.
replacement.address: Mon, Mon District, Nagaland — 135 km from Dibrugarh airport

replacement.name: Helsa Cottage
replacement.tagline: Mon town's canonical mid-budget stay since the 90s — a Konyak-family guesthouse with simple rooms, full-board meals (rice + bucket hot water + candle-lit power cuts), and an 'Aunty' who arranges Konyak-village guides.

replacement.name: Tourist Lodge, Forest Colony (Govt of Nagaland)
replacement.tagline: Government tourist lodge near the DC office in Forest Colony — a short walk from Mon Bazaar and the de facto starting point for permits and Konyak-village guides.
replacement.address: Forest Colony, Mon, Mon District, Nagaland

replacement.name: Traveller's Inn, Longwa (run by Angh's family)
replacement.tagline: Sits directly opposite the Konyak Angh's longhouse on the India-Myanmar border — sleep in a basic homestay where the chief lives in two countries and dinner is cooked over a central fireplace.
replacement.address: Longwa village, Mon District, Nagaland (Indo-Myanmar border, ~42 km from Mon town)
replacement.phone: Bookings via village contacts; Facebook page 'Travellers Inn Longwa'

replacement.name: Wander Nagaland Mini Tourist Homestay
replacement.tagline: Naga-owned homestay on the Kohima–Meluri road in Pfutsero town, run by the Wander Nagaland / Naga Homestay collective — the closest thing to a 'recommended' stay in a town that has only a handful of lodgings.
replacement.address: Kohima–Meluri Road, Pfutsero 798619, Phek District, Nagaland

replacement.name: Pfutsero Tourist Lodge (Govt of Nagaland)
replacement.tagline: Wooden lodge on a slope overlooking the entire town — book through the Tourism Department in Kohima; basic rooms, sweeping valley views, the de facto budget option in Nagaland's highest town.

replacement.name: Pfutsero Circuit House (PWD/Govt)
replacement.tagline: Government circuit house perched above the town with views over Pfutsero lake and the Chakhesang valleys — central location, must be pre-booked through the DC office or Kohima tourism.

task_b_results.name: Hotel Vivor Kohima
task_b_results.tagline: Niathu-Group 4-star with 29 rooms blending Naga handicraft and modern comfort — Tripadvisor #1 small hotel in Nagaland; mid-priced sweet spot between budget lodges and Niraamaya luxury.
task_b_results.address: Lower Agri, near Kohima Bible College, Kohima 797001, Nagaland

task_b_results.name: Hotel Lavisto
task_b_results.tagline: Directly opposite Kohima War Cemetery — 50 m from the entrance gate, 5-minute walk to Tibetan Market. Basic but clean rooms, balcony town views; the only stay where you can walk to the WWII memorial in slippers.

task_b_results.name: Razhu Pru
task_b_results.tagline: 1946 Angami family home in Kohima Village (the original settlement) turned heritage homestay — wooden floors, traditional Naga antiques, post-WWII history baked into the walls; 7 km from the War Cemetery, but the most atmospheric stay in town.
task_b_results.address: Opposite Baptist High Secondary School, Mission Compound, Kohima Village 797001, Nagaland

task_b_results.name: Happy Hues Homestay
task_b_results.tagline: 3-room family homestay run by Vikepeno and Apeno Pier — classic room ₹2,000, family room ₹2,600 (incl. breakfast); balcony view over Khonoma's terraced rice fields. Apeno's cooking and history stories are the draw.
task_b_results.address: Khonoma Village, Kohima District 797001, Nagaland (19 km from Kohima)

task_b_results.name: Dovipie Inn
task_b_results.tagline: 6-room boutique inn inside Khonoma village — closest to the Sopfunuo (warrior's wife) memorial gate and the stone-paved path to the 750-year-old terraces. Cozy hill-view rooms; bird and butterfly walks arranged by the family.

task_b_results.name: Dzuleke Eco-tourism Homestays (8 km from Khonoma)
task_b_results.tagline: 32-house Angami hamlet 8 km beyond Khonoma run as a TATA Trust eco-tourism cluster — basic homestays, trout streams, Blyth's tragopan birding; the 'further-in' stay for travellers who already did Khonoma village.
task_b_results.address: Dzuleke village, Kohima District, Nagaland (8 km west of Khonoma)

task_b_results.name: Hotel Whispering Winds
task_b_results.tagline: On D.C. Hill, the highest point of Mokokchung — modern 3-star with a Naga-cuisine restaurant, licensed bar and 360° valley views; the canonical 'comfortable' stay for visiting Ao-Naga heartland.
task_b_results.address: D.C. Hill, Sangtemla Ward, Mokokchung 798601, Nagaland

task_b_results.name: Marvel Guesthouse (Wander Nagaland)
task_b_results.tagline: Family-run guesthouse + homestay in Alongmen Ward, 3 minutes from the town square and bus stand — basic rooms, Ao hospitality, terrace 360° view; listed on the Naga Homestay collective and the cheapest decent option in town.
task_b_results.address: S.E. Colony Road, Alongmen Ward, Mokokchung 798601, Nagaland

task_b_results.name: Hotel Metsuben
task_b_results.tagline: Hilltop hotel above R. Kathing Park, 0.5 km from the centre — 10 spacious rooms, multi-cuisine restaurant, walking distance to the Town Hall and the Ao Senden building. The mid-range default since 1988.
task_b_results.address: R. Kathing Park, Mokokchung Compound, Mokokchung 798601, Nagaland

task_b_results.name: Mokokchung Circuit House (Govt of Nagaland)
task_b_results.tagline: Sangtemla Ward government circuit house — book through the DC office; basic but the only government-grade option, and the closest you get to a 'heritage administrative' stay in town.
